limitations: Same previously revealed500 sources; supplementary not fresh confirmatory validation.
G0-once actual intervention rates differ from Random-once; compare executable strategies, not pure timing at fixed realized budget.
Auxiliary D/G0/Q are historical five-task heads, no fullMT50 refit.
Post/Velocity/R ran on different hosts; compare logical calls cautiously, do not claim controlled timing superiority.
Random logs shadowD/G0 whose time/cost is included; do not describe this as minimal deployable random cost.
Table cost recomputation covers all valid task episodes, excluding historical technical-retry overhead retained in original receipts.
Task/source/bootstrap uncertainty does not include independent training seeds.

high_H_call_tradeoff_example.scope: Observed values, no paired uncertainty computed here. Logical policy calls only; additional D/G0/Q inference and gradients excluded from this scalar, so no nettime/netcompute assertion.
